name: Projected Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension / Projected Maximum Positive Degree
details: For nonempty finite binary classes, projected positive no-clashing teaching dimension equals projected maximum positive degree (and projected positive recursive teaching dimension). Positivity forces the upper concept's teacher to include every coordinate of a lower one-inclusion neighbour; the converse follows from the minimal-positive-teaching-set argument.
proof_source: Proposition \ref{prop:positive-projection-collapse} in the survey; independent small-class regression: sync/verify_positive_projection_collapse.py.
